description: This file defines a React functional component named ViewDetailsModal which renders a modal dialog displaying detailed information of a generic JSON object. It includes utility functions for formatting labels and currency display, and handles special cases such as user cost keys. The component is designed to be reused across the application for inspecting arbitrary data objects.

methods.name: ViewDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal showing key-value pairs of a data object, with special formatting for user cost keys.
